callees.name: _split_env_paths
callees.pre_condition: env_value is a string containing zero or more paths separated by the system path separator
callees.post_condition: Returns a list of individual path strings obtained by splitting env_value on the system path separator, with empty segments excluded

callees.name: _flatten_paths
callees.pre_condition: cli_paths is an iterable that may contain strings and/or nested iterables of strings
callees.post_condition: Returns a flat list of all string elements from cli_paths, with any nested iterables recursively flattened

callees.name: resolve_domain_knowledge_paths
callees.pre_condition: paths is a list of string path entries; base_dir is a string path to an existing directory; fallback_base_dir, if provided, is a string path to an existing directory
callees.post_condition: Returns a list of absolute file paths as strings. Each input path is first resolved against base_dir to an absolute path; if that path does not exist and fallback_base_dir is provided, the path is instead resolved against fallback_base_dir. Only paths that resolve to existing files are included in the result.
